disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件读取 API Key 的全部路径：通过 DSH 凭据通道解析 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，兜底读取同名环境变量；Key 仅作为 Bearer 头随余额查询请求发出，未出现在日志、错误信息、页面接口返回或浏览器端代码中。
checked_items.en: Checked all paths where the plugin reads API Key: resolves DEEPSEEK_API_KEY via DSH credential channel, falls back to reading the environment variable of the same name; Key is only sent as a Bearer header with the balance query request, not present in logs, error messages, page API responses, or browser-side code.

checked_items.zh: 全树扫描未发现硬编码密钥、云凭据枚举命令或钱包/助记词访问；README 中提及凭据存储文件路径的文字属于故障排查说明，不是代码读取行为。
checked_items.en: Full-tree scan did not find hardcoded keys, cloud credential enumeration commands, or wallet/mnemonic access; the text in README mentioning credential storage file paths is a troubleshooting explanation, not a code reading behavior.

evidence.zh: 余额查询会使用 DSH 凭据通道中的 API Key，但该 Key 只随余额接口请求发出（官方或用户配置的中转端点），不会进入浏览器响应，也没有任何其他外发路径。
evidence.en: The balance query uses the API Key from the DSH credential channel, but the Key is only sent with the balance interface request (official or user-configured relay endpoint), does not enter the browser response, and has no other outbound paths.

checked_items.zh: 插件未注册任何面向模型/LLM 的工具，也没有注入系统提示词片段；面向模型的挂载面只是一个 UI 插槽组件，文案为固定的中英文字典，无指令性内容。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not register any tool for model/LLM, nor does it inject any system prompt fragments; the model-facing mount surface is just a UI slot component, with text being a fixed Chinese-English dictionary, no directive content.

checked_items.zh: 全树未发现代理指令文件（如 AGENTS.md、SKILL.md、MCP 配置等）；README 与文档为常规使用说明，未发现要求模型执行、忽略规则或拉取远端指令的文字。
checked_items.en: No proxy instruction files found in the full tree (e.g., AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, MCP config, etc.); README and documentation are regular usage instructions, no text found that requires the model to execute, ignore rules, or pull remote instructions.

evidence.zh: 插件不注册任何工具描述、也不注入系统提示词，模型上下文里不会出现本插件产生的文本，投毒面不存在。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register any tool descriptions, nor does it inject system prompts; no text generated by this plugin appears in the model context, so there is no poisoning surface.

evidence.zh: 插件没有面向模型的描述文本，不存在借工具描述诱导模型执行安装、改写配置或放开权限的入口。
evidence.en: The plugin has no model-facing description text, and there is no entry point to induce the model to execute installation, modify configuration, or grant permissions through tool descriptions.

checked_items.zh: 扫描源码与构建产物，未发现动态执行代码的调用（求值、动态函数、子进程等）；安装钩子只有一条打包命令，运行项目自带的打包器，无远程下载执行内容。
checked_items.en: Scanned source code and build artifacts, no dynamic code execution calls found (eval, dynamic functions, subprocesses, etc.); the install hook has only one build command, which runs the project's own bundler, no remote download and execute content.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置仅插入一行插件声明，没有可执行脚本标记；浏览器端包只包含余额展示组件与同源接口轮询，无键盘监听、剪贴板访问或凭据写入调用。
checked_items.en: The patch config only inserts one plugin declaration line, no executable script mark; the browser-side bundle only contains the balance display component and same-origin interface polling, no keyboard listening, clipboard access, or credential write calls.

checked_items.zh: 源码与编译产物内容逐文件比对一致，未发现构建阶段夹带额外代码；未发现混淆、动态解码载荷或超长编码串。
checked_items.en: Source code and compiled artifacts are consistent file-by-file, no extra code injected during build; no obfuscation, dynamic decoding payloads, or overly long encoded strings found.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置只声明一个插件行，未使用任何可执行脚本标记，不存在配置即执行面。
evidence.en: The patch config only declares one plugin line, does not use any executable script mark, no configuration-as-execution surface.

evidence.zh: 插件没有调用宿主提供的动态代码包工具，源码与产物中均未发现任何引用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not call any dynamic code package tools provided by the host; no references found in source or artifacts.

evidence.zh: 唯一的安装钩子是打包命令，属常规构建步骤（用项目自己的打包器产出产物），无外联、无凭据读取、无隐蔽下载执行，按工程惯例排除。
evidence.en: The only install hook is a build command, which is a regular build step (using the project's own bundler to produce artifacts), no outbound connections, no credential reading, no covert download and execute, excluded per engineering convention.

evidence.zh: 清单声明了浏览器端包；产物精读后确认只含余额 chip 组件：轮询同源余额接口、点击展开明细，没有键盘、剪贴板或凭据相关调用。
evidence.en: The manifest declares a browser-side bundle; after careful reading of the artifact, it confirms only contains the balance chip component: polls the same-origin balance interface, expands details on click, no keyboard, clipboard, or credential-related calls.

checked_items.zh: 梳理了全部出站请求：余额查询（官方 DeepSeek 余额接口或用户配置的中转端点）、官方价格页抓取（每 6 小时）、浏览器端仅请求同源接口；未发现裸 IP、隧道、编码外发、paste/Webhook 等隐蔽通道，也未发现改写 AI 端点或代理环境变量的行为。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all outbound requests: balance query (official DeepSeek balance interface or user-configured relay endpoint), official pricing page fetch (every 6 hours), browser-side only requests same-origin interface; no bare IP, tunnel, encoded exfiltration, paste/Webhook, or other covert channels found, nor any behavior of modifying AI endpoints or proxy environment variables.

checked_items.zh: API Key 只随余额查询请求发送；价格页抓取只解析价格数字用于展示，不执行抓取内容。
checked_items.en: API Key is only sent with the balance query request; the pricing page fetch only parses the price numbers for display, does not execute the fetched content.

evidence.zh: 插件确实会把 API Key 发往余额查询端点，这是其核心功能；除此之外没有任何外发目的地，Key 不进入浏览器端，凭证外泄链不成立。
evidence.en: The plugin does send the API Key to the balance query endpoint, which is its core functionality; besides that, there is no other outbound destination, the Key does not enter the browser side, so the credential exfiltration chain does not hold.

checked_items.zh: 依赖均为官方 dsh SDK、React 与常用小工具，未发现与生态常见命名撞车的疑似抢注包，也无未锁定版本的 git 依赖。
checked_items.en: Dependencies are all official dsh SDK, React, and common utilities; no suspicious packages that collide with common ecosystem names (squatting), and no unversioned git dependencies.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置，无禁用开关、无环境变量降权、无注入/拦截改写；未注册任何安全事件的高优先级监听。
checked_items.en: The patch config does not touch security configurations such as sandbox, approval, permissions; no disable switches, no environment variable privilege reduction, no injection/interception modifications; no high-priority listeners registered for any security events.

checked_items.zh: 作者身份未经平台验证，属一般性提示，不作为风险；包清单 repository 字段与被审仓库不一致，属来源元数据疑点，已记入审计范围说明。
checked_items.en: The author's identity has not been verified by the platform; this is a general note, not a risk; the package manifest's repository field is inconsistent with the audited repository, which is a source metadata anomaly, recorded in the audit scope notes.

checked_items.zh: 包清单未单独声明网络能力，但 README 与代码对联网行为（余额查询、价格页抓取）有完整说明，属透明度缺口而非隐瞒，已记入能力对账。
checked_items.en: The package manifest does not separately declare network capability, but the README and code provide a complete description of network behavior (balance query, pricing page fetch); this is a transparency gap, not concealment, and has been recorded in the capability reconciliation.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置只插入插件自身的一行声明，没有触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置，也没有禁用或降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts the plugin's own declaration line, does not touch security configurations such as sandbox, approval, permissions, and does not have any disable or privilege reduction patterns.

evidence.zh: 插件没有对工具执行前或审批请求等安全事件注册任何监听，不存在截断审批链的可能。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register any listeners for security events such as pre-tool execution or approval requests; there is no possibility of truncating the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计没有历史版本可比较，无法评估升级自动激活面。
evidence.en: First audit, no historical versions to compare, unable to evaluate the upgrade auto-activation surface.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置没有改写注入/拦截配置，不影响其他插件依赖的服务。
evidence.en: The patch config does not modify injection/interception configurations, and does not affect services that other plugins depend on.

checked_items.zh: 插件在宿主 web 服务上注册三个只读 JSON 接口（余额、刷新、会话花费），自身不监听端口、不启动独立服务；这些接口无鉴权属 DSH 宿主固有设计，非本插件引入的问题。
checked_items.en: The plugin registers three read-only JSON endpoints on the host web service (balance, refresh, session cost); it does not listen on ports or start independent services; these endpoints lack authentication, which is inherent to the DSH host design, not an issue introduced by this plugin.

checked_items.zh: 手动记账模式把账本写入 DSH 设置命名空间并标记为隐藏、敏感字段，测试证实该字段不会出现在设置传输值中，也不会随余额响应发给浏览器。
checked_items.en: The manual accounting mode writes the ledger to the DSH settings namespace and marks it as hidden and sensitive; tests confirm that this field does not appear in the settings transmission values, and is not sent to the browser with the balance response.

evidence.zh: 插件不在自身进程内启动 Web 服务或监听端口，只是复用宿主已有的路由注册机制；宿主本机接口无认证属生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on ports within its own process; it only reuses the host's existing route registration mechanism; the host's local interface lacks authentication, which is an inherent risk of the ecosystem, not introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 清单声明齐全（挂载配置 + 浏览器端包），补丁内容与声明一致；作者身份未经平台验证，无品牌仿冒迹象。
summary.en: Manifest declarations are complete (patch config + browser-side bundle); patch content matches declarations; the author's identity has not been verified by the platform, no signs of brand impersonation.

summary.zh: 静态扫描未发现危险执行、硬编码密钥或外联后门；机械命中的条目（源码映射、编译产物超长行、构建钩子、README 文档提及）逐条核查后均属良性。
summary.en: Static scanning did not find dangerous execution, hardcoded keys, or outbound backdoors; mechanically hit entries (source maps, overly long lines in compiled artifacts, build hooks, README mentions) were reviewed one by one and are all benign.

summary.zh: 行为分析确认出站请求仅指向官方余额/价格页与用户配置端点，API Key 无外泄路径；安装钩子为常规构建命令。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis confirmed that outbound requests only point to the official balance/pricing pages and user-configured endpoints; API Key has no exfiltration path; the install hook is a regular build command.

summary.zh: 无工具描述与系统提示词注入面；浏览器端包行为与声明一致。
summary.en: No tool description or system prompt injection surface; the browser-side bundle behavior matches the declaration.

summary.zh: 未提供动态沙箱产物，未做动态验证。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox artifacts provided; no dynamic verification performed.

undeclared_observed.zh: 网络请求能力（查询 DeepSeek 余额接口、抓取官方价格页）未在包清单中单独声明；清单只声明了挂载配置与浏览器端注入，未提供能力声明字段，报告中的能力声明为代码实测推断。
undeclared_observed.en: Network request capability (querying DeepSeek balance interface, fetching official pricing page) is not separately declared in the package manifest; the manifest only declares the patch config and browser-side injection, does not provide a capability declaration field; the capability declaration in the report is inferred from actual code testing.

limits.zh:
未做动态沙箱验证（未提供动态产物），DG-L4 标注 na。

包清单未提供能力声明字段，报告中的能力声明为对代码实测的推断；清单未单独声明网络能力，已记入能力对账（undeclared_observed）。

package.json 的 repository 字段指向 github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui.git，与被审仓库 github.com/ghost011118/dsh-balance-meter 不一致，疑为从 dsh-web-ui 仓库派生或抽取，属来源元数据不一致，不影响本次代码结论。

机械扫描 6 条命中逐条裁决（均判定良性、不立 finding）：1) DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）@ lib/client.js.map:1 — 生成产物 source map 的超长单行，JSON 结构固有，非混淆；2) DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）@ lib/types/client/BalanceDockEntry.js:112 — 编译后的 JSX 渲染长行，与源码逐字一致，非混淆；3) DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）@ lib/types/service.d.ts.map:1 — 生成产物 source map，非混淆；4) DSH-X02（DG-R3-54）@ package.json:14 — prepare 为常规构建钩子，运行项目自带打包器，无远程代码与凭据访问，按工程惯例排除；5) DSH-C01（DG-R1-51）@ README.md:131 — 文档提及凭据存储路径，属故障排查说明，非代码读取；6) DSH-C01（DG-R1-51）@ README.zh.md:99 — 同前，中文文档说明。
limits.en:
No dynamic sandbox verification performed (no dynamic artifacts provided), DG-L4 marked as na.

The package manifest does not provide a capability declaration field; the capability declaration in the report is inferred from actual code testing. The manifest does not separately declare network capability, recorded in capability reconciliation (undeclared_observed).

The repository field in package.json points to github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui.git, inconsistent with the audited repository github.com/ghost011118/dsh-balance-meter; suspected to be forked or extracted from the dsh-web-ui repository, this is a source metadata inconsistency, does not affect the code conclusion of this audit.

Mechanically scanned 6 hits, adjudicated one by one (all judged benign, no finding raised): 1) DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）@ lib/client.js.map:1 — generated product source map excessively long single line, inherent to JSON structure, not obfuscation; 2) DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）@ lib/types/client/BalanceDockEntry.js:112 — compiled JSX rendering long line, verbatim matching source code, not obfuscation; 3) DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）@ lib/types/service.d.ts.map:1 — generated product source map, not obfuscation; 4) DSH-X02（DG-R3-54）@ package.json:14 — prepare is a regular build hook, runs the project's own bundler, no remote code or credential access, excluded per engineering convention; 5) DSH-C01（DG-R1-51）@ README.md:131 — documentation mentions credential storage path, belongs to troubleshooting explanation, not code reading; 6) DSH-C01（DG-R1-51）@ README.zh.md:99 — same as above, Chinese documentation explanation.
